block.guhs.kaaskas.lore: The heart of a glass greenhouse. With vadskracht (12) and kaassaus the crops around it (9 by 9) grow much faster. Vahoeg many nibbles!
item.guhs.kaaskas.lore: Put it among your crops and give it vadskracht (12) and a bucket of kaassaus.
gui.guhs.kaaskas.wacht_saus: Waiting for kaassaus (bucket or Sauce Hose)
block.guhs.sorteerband.lore: What lies on it rides along to the end. There a guh with the chore Sorter puts it in the right chest. Njeg, tidy is nice!
gui.guhs.klus.kassier.tip: Walks into the Cheese Greenhouse, picks everything that is ripe in one go and plants it again right away. The harvest goes to the chest or the Bank Guh. Only in a greenhouse of yours. (Guhs)
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.kassier.g: Nothing ripe yet. Crops growing in your greenhouses: %s
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.kassier.n: a Cheese Greenhouse you placed yourself in the chore area, with crops around it. They pick everything that is ripe and plant it again.
I picked the whole greenhouse empty! It smelled of cheese and little plants. Vahoeg.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.klusjes.kassier: Did you know there is a greenhouse full of nibbles at %s? I pick it empty. Njeg!
gui.guhs.klus.sorteerder.tip: Waits at the end of a Guh Sorting Belt, picks up what arrives and puts it in the chest that already holds that kind. Put one thing in a chest yourself and it knows where it belongs. (Guhs)
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.sorteerde: Things waiting at the end of a sorting belt: %s
Sorting belts: %s. Nothing is waiting right now
No sorting belt in the chore area
a Guh Sorting Belt in the chore area, and chests next to the huisje that already hold one of each kind. What has no chest of its own goes to the Bank Guh or another chest.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.klusjes_sorteerd: Everything went into the right chest. I am vahoeg tidy today.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.klusjes.sorteerder: Did you know a belt runs at %s? I sort everything into the right chest!
